mapper.select: SELECT bd_psndoc.code, bd_psndoc.name, bd_psndoc.pk_psndoc, org_dept.code deptcode, om_post.postname FROM nc65.bd_psndoc INNER JOIN nc65.hi_psnorg ON bd_psndoc.pk_psndoc = hi_psnorg.pk_psndoc INNER JOIN nc65.hi_psnjob ON hi_psnorg.pk_psnorg = hi_psnjob.pk_psnorg inner join nc65.om_post on om_post.pk_post = hi_psnjob.pk_post inner join nc65.org_dept on org_dept.pk_dept = hi_psnjob.pk_dept WHERE hi_psnjob.pk_psnjob IN ( SELECT hi_psnjob.pk_psnjob FROM nc65.bd_psndoc INNER JOIN nc65.hi_psnorg hi_psnorg ON bd_psndoc.pk_psndoc = hi_psnorg.pk_psndoc INNER JOIN nc65.hi_psnjob hi_psnjob ON hi_psnorg.pk_psnorg = hi_psnjob.pk_psnorg where hi_psnorg.indocflag = 'Y' AND hi_psnorg.psntype = 0 AND hi_psnjob.lastflag = 'Y' AND hi_psnjob.ismainjob = 'Y' and hi_psnjob.endflag = 'N') ORDER BY hi_psnjob.showorder
